description: Entry rules for one passport and destination: entry mode, allowed length of stay, how the days are counted (per entry or in a rolling window), whether a visa run resets the counter, and temporary vehicle import. Answers carry a confidence level and source — pass those on instead of stating a rule as certain.

destination.description: Destination: ISO alpha-2 code, slug or zone code, e.g. TR.

passport.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the passport, e.g. RU.

plate.description: Plate origin for the green card rule.

weight.description: Vehicle weight class for the vehicle rule: le35 (<=3.5 t) or gt35.

name: check_visa_rules
title: Check Visa Rules
